method: Measured horizontal closed-hole mesh sections, median observed canal-centroid proxies (superior C1 boundary uses highest observed sections); source-only monotone piecewise transfer with explicitly bounded constant-displacement boundary translation. No estimated nerve path or radius rescaling. These proxies are not medically annotated canal landmarks.
collisionScreenLimit: Vertex-in-solid screen only; not a complete triangle-intersection/canal-clearance test. Open/reduced source meshes can affect parity. No zero-collision medical claim.
junctionScreenLimit: Bounding-envelope distance only, not verified continuity with medulla.
remainingGates: Review detected hole correspondence and canal axes
Complete geometric surface-intersection and clearance assessment
Anatomist annotation of cranial junction and conus
Separate 31 spinal pairs audit; cord segments are not spinal nerve pairs
